I've ran TitanCNA 1.4.0 on my data (1 healthy control, 3 patients) and did see a strange behaviour in the WGS dataset (50X Illumina X)  i'm using. (Demo runs just fine and with same/similar results as shown on webpage)

All regions in my patient files are marked as having a duplication? Using other methods like FreeC, this is not happening?

There is one difference I've found in the params: the S_Dbw values are extremely low compared to the demo/example:

messages.body_plain:
Hi Anthony,

Thank you for your interest in TITAN.  TitanCNA requires input data from germline heterozygous SNP sites.  This is generally determined from the matched normal.  In your situation, it appears you do not have the matched normal setup. Can you confirm this?  In the figures, we can see many homozygous SNPs which I suspect are probably not heterozygous in the germline.

TitanCNA requires matched tumour-normal pairs, particularly for identifying germline heterozygous SNPs.  There is growing interest for applying TitanCNA to tumour-only samples; however, this is not currently included as a feature.

Hope this helps.

Best,
Gavin
